_readme: Decision tree. events pick an entry node for a gameplay trigger (end_of_day, big_customer, supplier_offer). Nodes: id, speaker, text, choices, effects, requires, sets_flags, next. A node with no choices uses next. next "END" closes the conversation. requires: flags (all), any_flags, not_flags, min/max stat thresholds. Effect sizes are labelled estimates (game design, not statistics). minDay/priority are scheduling, not balance.
